raw_definitions: Definisi : ~ up, climb easily and quickly, memanjat [sst] dgn mudah: the boy ~ned up the coconut palm, budak itu memanjat pokok kelapa dgn mudah. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : ~ down, climb down easily and quickly, turun dr [sst] dgn mudah: she ~ned down the tree, dia turun dr pokok itu dgn mudah; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n front part of lower leg, tulang kering: he got a blow on the ~ from the other man’s hockey stick, tulang keringnya kena pukul dgn kayu hoki pemain lain; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
